body:
@vinhlh Thanks for opening this issue.

We took this approach so one could do:

```jsx
const AwesomeRefinementList = connectRefinementList(AwesomeRefinementListComponent);

<AwesomeRefinementList attributeName="brands" />
<AwesomeRefinementList attributeName="materials" />
```

And this actually works, if it does not then we failed somewhere, open a bug.

instead of

```jsx
const Brands = connectRefinementList(AwesomeRefinementListComponent, {attributeName: 'brands'});
const Materials = connectRefinementList(AwesomeRefinementListComponent, {attributeName: 'materials'});

<Brands />
<Materials />
```

But if you like it, you could just do:

```jsx
const AwesomeRefinementList = connectRefinementList(AwesomeRefinementListComponent);
const Brands = <AwesomeRefinementList attributeName="brands" />;
const Materials = <AwesomeRefinementList attributeName="materials" />;

<Brands />
<Materials />
```

Is you proposal bringing or coming from anything else than syntax preference?
